response.sql: WITH pr AS (SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id, p.fundflux AS funding_source, SUM(s.boxx) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.boxz), 0) AS ratio FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux), x AS (SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS excess FROM pr) SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, excess FROM x ORDER BY excess IS NULL, excess DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A project whose boxz total is 0 or entirely missing has a NULL ratio. It is left out of its funding source's average and sorts last, because its excess is NULL.
Projects with a NULL funding source are treated as one group for the average.
